seo.title: CAP — Content, Analytics & Production Agency in Dhaka
seo.description: CAP is a creative agency in Dhaka, Bangladesh, bringing content, analytics and production into one creative system — from strategy to launch.

hero.intro: CAP is a Dhaka-based creative agency that turns ideas into films, animations, ads and audio-visual content people actually want to watch — with sharp storytelling, solid craft and a little creative mischief.

statement.text: Most agencies separate the brief from the build.
statement.body: Strategy, data and craft sit inside one team, in one room, on one timeline. That means sharper ideas before execution begins — and work that gets out the door without losing what made it good.

about.headline: Partners with taste,
paragraphs: Content Analytics Production (CAP) is a Dhaka-based creative agency that turns ideas into films, animations, ads and audio-visual content people actually want to watch. From screens to stages, we mix sharp storytelling, solid craft and a little creative mischief to deliver work that connects — beautifully and effectively.

Content gives us ideas, narrative and strategy. Analytics gives us insights, audience and optimization. Production gives us execution, visuals and experience. Because all three sit in one team, clients move from strategy to launch without managing disconnected agencies.

beliefs.title: Culturally alive
beliefs.text: Ideas that feel culturally alive instead of mechanically polished.

beliefs.title: Clear by design
beliefs.text: Clear positioning, sharper decisions, and less noise between teams.

beliefs.title: Disciplined craft
beliefs.text: Production discipline that gets work out without eroding the original idea.

about.quote: We make work that can survive the brief, the deadline, and the audience.

cta.headline: Let's make something
cta.text: Thank you for spending time with our work. Tell us what you're building — we look forward to what we can create together.

careersIntro.headline: Work with
careersIntro.text: We are a young, fast-moving crew of writers, analysts, designers and filmmakers. If you want your work to be seen — and to matter — we'd like to meet you. No open role that fits? Send your portfolio anyway.

faq.a: Three connected service lines. Content: creative strategy, campaign ideation, brand storytelling, influencer campaigns and social content systems. Analytics: audience intelligence, digital campaign systems, performance optimization, media planning and websites & reporting. Production: film, reels & commercials, animation & motion, photography and post-production & AI.
Our studio is on Road No. 1, Niketon, Gulshan 1, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

faq.q: Do you work with international clients?
faq.a: Yes. We're based in Dhaka and work with both local and international brands and organizations.
Strategy, data and production sit inside one team. We don't just create content — we build data-informed marketing systems that scale with your ambitions.

privacy.title: Data we collect
privacy.text: Contact details, project briefs, and analytics data used to improve our services.

privacy.title: How we use data
privacy.text: To respond to inquiries, deliver services, and inform performance reporting.

privacy.title: Storage & retention
privacy.text: Project data is stored securely and retained for up to 24 months post-engagement.

privacy.title: Your rights
privacy.text: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting us.

terms.title: Engagement scope
terms.text: Project scopes are defined in a written statement of work outlining deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.

terms.title: Payment terms
terms.text: Invoices are issued monthly with a standard 14-day payment window unless otherwise agreed.

terms.title: Intellectual property
terms.text: Upon final payment, clients receive usage rights for approved deliverables, excluding third-party assets.

terms.title: Confidentiality
terms.text: We keep shared business information confidential and apply NDAs when required.
